---
name: Good first issue
about: A small, scoped task suitable for a first-time contributor (maintainer use)
title: "[Good first issue] "
labels: good first issue
assignees: ''
---

**What needs to be done**
A clear, narrow description of the task. Link the exact file(s)/function(s) involved if possible.

**Why it matters**
One or two sentences of context so the contributor understands the purpose.

**Expected outcome**
What "done" looks like (e.g. tests pass, a specific behavior changes).

**Pointers to get started**
- Relevant file(s): `...`
- Relevant docs/section: `...`
- Anyone can comment below to claim this issue before starting.

**Difficulty:** small / scoped, no deep codebase knowledge required.
